summary: Aurelion Research appears in Part 4, Part 8, Part 10 of The Buildout. Part 4: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill; Part 8: AI Lenders Are Financing the End of Scarcity; Part 10: The Bubble Is in the Denominator. Argued in Part 8 (The spending pays).

parts.headline: AI Spending Has Met Its First Real Bill
AI Lenders Are Financing the End of Scarcity
The Bubble Is in the Denominator

mentions.excerpt: Aurelion Research measures the fragility in expectations.

Aurelion Research sees the customer base widening from a handful of hyperscalers to enterprises, AI-native companies and smaller clouds, on top of more than $3.1 trillion of expected AI infrastructure commitments.
Aurelion Research points to corporations, AI startups and other clouds, with more than $3.1 trillion of infrastructure commitments in prospect.

sides.claim: The customer base is broadening beyond a concentrated set of hyperscalers to enterprises, AI-native companies and cloud providers, with AI-related infrastructure commitments expected to exceed $3.1 trillion, making the next phase of demand less…

Hyperscaler capex is durable rather than at risk of a sudden cut, because the largest spenders keep reaffirming the necessity of AI investment and their EBITDA and EBIT margins are still rising, giving them capacity to keep funding it.
